title: Call sheet
description: A crew roster where every cell edits in place — arrows and Tab move the selection, Enter opens it, and a commit turns pending, flashes, then settles. Undo rides a countdown toast for five seconds before the edit sticks for good.
intent: A real spreadsheet-grade interface component — roving-tabindex keyboard grid, optimistic commit states, undoable edits — matching Herb's preference for finished interface mechanics over abstract demos.
